body:
## Finding

PR [#1442](https://github.com/ChengshuLi/WorldAtlas/pull/1442), merge `6a1c3b5410587289285f31809312792f0f085e87`, adds a correct full 268-row source crosswalk reproducer, but its receipt-path admission misses a file/ancestor collision. The unchanged real CLI accepts `reproduction-summary.json/receipt.json`. It computes and writes all six mandatory results, then fails with `FileExistsError` because `reproduction-summary.json` is already a regular file. The run has no completion receipt. This leaves a failed, partial output vintage after a request the CLI should reject before work.

Actual isolated exact-merge reproduction used the unchanged command and source/integrity logic; only input/output transport was redirected to an exclusively owned private review namespace. It exited 1 after writing `baseline-input-digests.json`, the complete `subject-source-crosswalk.jsonl` (268 rows; 117,620 bytes; SHA-256 `e69458d74688645a3fdde4a7dfba15cf2b13310bb2cb15df13860d566ebb15f3`), `reproduction-summary.json`, both control results and `legacy-controls.json`. No completion receipt appeared. All six whole failed outputs are retained with hashes. The already successful original run outputs and every original source remain unchanged.

The matching issue [#1511](https://github.com/ChengshuLi/WorldAtlas/issues/1511) is restricted to Saudi Arabia PR #1357 and a different owned source packet. It does not cover this 268-subject South Atlantic CLI. No existing issue covers this collision in this packet.

## Reproduction

At exact PR #1442 head `11de256dce15785faa9ed533fa4706ab5b51fc44`, execute the real `reproduce_integrity.py` with fresh run name `audit-receipt-ancestor` and receipt argument `reproduction-summary.json/receipt.json`. Current behavior: exit 1, six mandatory outputs are present, receipt is absent. Expected behavior: reject before source/archive reads, validation controls or output-directory creation; all earlier outputs remain unchanged.

## Scope and acceptance

One additive successor under `coordination/engineering/south-atlantic-receipt-admission-1442/`, one PR, dependent on closed #1369. Preserve the original `research/geography/south-atlantic-reuse-integrity-1146-erratum/` packet and exact 268 subject IDs. Bind all 36 original inputs from the exact commit/path/bytes/SHA-256 pins recorded in `source-pins.json` (full pin map below), plus exact successor code pins. No edits to the source packet, original producer, shared geography/hierarchy, legal or rights claims, imports, publication, deployment, or geography approval.

The successor must validate the complete output/receipt namespace before expensive work or any output creation. Reject a receipt whose path equals a required output or whose ancestor collides with a required output filename, including the demonstrated request. Reject traversal, escaped, existing, dangling-link or linked-ancestor destinations while preserving earlier evidence. Continue to honor a safe nested `receipts/run.json` destination. Two fresh actual CLI runs must still reproduce the complete original crosswalk byte for byte and the regular duplicate/missing/ambiguous/input-mutation controls must remain meaningful. Preserve complete outputs and failures; completion receipt is published last.

### Success criteria

- Exact 268-ID scope and all 36 pins remain bound; source/legal/geometry uncertainties stay explicit.
- Reproduce the demonstrated receipt-parent collision on the successor and prove admission rejects it before outputs or computation. Test sibling receipt filename collisions and safe nested receipt paths.
- Exercise the actual CLI for existing file/directory, dangling and ancestor links, traversal/escape, wrong receipt extension, and successful complete runs. Record full predecessor bytes and literal link targets; rejected admission creates nothing or changes nothing.
- Two fresh complete positive runs match each other and the retained 268-row crosswalk exactly. Positive and negative controls remain nonvacuous.
- Preserve complete original/candidate/runtime/output inputs under 32 MiB ordinary and 256 MiB complete-phase limits; original source packet and all prior outputs remain byte-identical.
- Complete shared read-only readiness, overlap/dependency/worker-ownership review before marking ready.

Limits: this defect is a receipt-path admission and failed-partial-output issue. It does not change the verified crosswalk, prove polygon equivalence, resolve derivative rights, establish current/legal boundaries or approve geography.

First independently confirmed: 2026-10-08 (America/Los_Angeles); earlier occurrence unknown.

title: Reject South Atlantic source receipt path collisions before reproduction

body:
Parent audit #726. Affected [PR #1384](https://github.com/ChengshuLi/WorldAtlas/pull/1384), exact merge `281424146684b98e754efba910178c7b42f3850a`. Independently demonstrated 2026-10-08 America/Los_Angeles by Auditor `01a10892-0782-7b13-902c-d8b4db6c155d`; earlier occurrence date unknown. Preserve closed #1377, its complete31-component source-only acceptance and all original evidence. This bounded engineering successor corrects evidence admission, preservation and numerical reporting. It does not authorize geographic changes or source/legal approval.

## Independently demonstrated defects

1. **Complete-operation admission is absent.** `build_evidence.py` consumes all11 original candidate custody shards and all18 native metadata parts, plus27 physical-query source parts, the complete numeric scope and county sources in one builder. Whole-byte/hash/CRC/decoded identity checks independently authenticate the11 candidate shards (22,523,564 encoded +90,788,892 decoded) and18 native metadata parts (28,542,843 encoded +143,180,292 decoded). Their distinct complete raw-plus-decoded identities alone total **285,035,591 bytes**, above256MiB (**268,435,456**) before other inputs, runtime, fixtures or outputs. Resetting a helper/chunk budget within this same builder would not fix it. Separately, `extract_tigerline_targets.py` reads national archives of79,219,478/83,989,800 bytes and full shapefile members into ordinary representations; the retained2018 SHP alone is127,329,136 bytes. These exceed32MiB ordinary/decompressed-object admission. Its archive guard checks size and computes a receipt hash, rather than comparing the consumed archive to a fixed expected hash before extraction. The full original builder and national extraction were **not executed** by this audit.

2. **Actual writers overwrite or redirect retained evidence.** The unmodified builder `write_bytes` callable accepts an existing ordinary sentinel, a dangling destination symlink and a linked ancestor. Actual complete `prepare_manifest.py` CLI calls overwrite an existing manifest and follow a linked manifest to overwrite a sentinel outside the fixture. Actual complete byte-identical `capture_tigerweb_source.py` CLI calls accept occupied/dangling destinations and overwrite/redirect the135,074-byte capture. Those capture controls mock the two HTTP bodies with the complete authentic retained responses, so they establish local writer behavior rather than live-network behavior. Only fresh private auditor fixtures were mutated; all48 original files stayed unchanged.

3. **Required numerical fields can disappear without rejection.** In a complete copied packet fixture, remove all27 required IoU fields from the county comparisons in `per-component-source-screen.json`, preserving every subject, other measurements and input file. The unchanged actual `prepare_manifest.py` CLI exits0, refreshes file hashes and publishes `metrics: []` and `metric_bindings: []`. The actual shared byte validator with a reviewed fixture reader reports `limited` and checks58 files; it does not reject the missing results. This is acceptance of incomplete numerical evidence, not a claim that the shared byte validator certifies scientific truth. This computed packet needs truthful generated/mixed evidence and exact relationships between required results, reports and prose, rather than source-only empty numerical bindings. The intact retained54 county measurements and465 component/source predicates do independently reproduce.

4. **“Exactly match” is false for the retained2025-versus2026 geometries.** README says the2025 TIGERline geometries exactly match2026 after transformation. Actual EPSG:5070 measurements reproduce positive symmetric differences: Nassau36059 **2.5645401430321018m²**, Suffolk36103 **5.842783827795448m²**, Westchester36119 **2.700928558507014m²**; all three actual geometric equality checks are false. Corresponding IoUs are0.9999999978160244,0.9999999990494451 and0.9999999979146712. These are very close comparisons; precision/CRS representation may explain them. No historical/legal boundary change or physical-land cause is inferred. Preserve the original numbers and dated prose, then publish a supported additive correction describing near agreement rather than exact equality.

title: Guard USA31 #1384 complete reproduction, preserved outputs and numerical reporting

body:
First raised 2026-10-07 (America/Los_Angeles) by post-merge Auditor `01a10892-0782-7b13-902c-d8b4db6c155d`. Original corrective PR #1259, exact merge `c9bd47774b1ea8216d9cd4608ce2a20e15a2962b`, head `7ea7ed93193f1b3af162f99bd38207c2f82f16c8`. Preserve closed #1252, #978 and #427 and their original audit outcomes. This is a new control-integrity remainder; the successful frozen main-runner, native duplicate joins, exclusive single-file writer, and all 59 metric/table corrections remain intact. Broader #1149 and distinct comparator/county-lineage follow-ups #1258/#1257 have separate code/scope and ownership.

Inspected findings (static code evidence; adverse entrypoint reproductions have NOT yet run):

1. `data/regional-review/southeastern-county-vintage-978-erratum/verify-controls-v2.py`, whole SHA256 `a27cdf2a9670079c72021abf7b3d58b1469efe330dda7de54fc713fb46fe920f`, 7,629 bytes: lines 119–128 read two purported run JSON files and establish only `len(result["subjects"]) == 6`, `result["runner_sha256"] == args.runner_sha256`, and equality of their whole file hashes. There is no comparison to the exact six distinct acceptance IDs, immutable inventory/baseline, actual geometry/IoU/metric fields or source/code/output provenance. The same invented six rows, duplicate subject rows or changed scientific values in both files satisfy these inspected predicates, yet lines 128–139 construct a passed reproducibility control whose scope claims all six identities, joins, geometry summaries, frozen IoUs and rosters. Equal arbitrary files do not support that scope. Authentic originals currently match; this finding does not allege they contain false scientific values.
2. Lines 131–136 preflight each of three output destinations only immediately before publishing that file. If the first destination is fresh but the second or third already exists, earlier fresh `positive-control-v2.json` (and possibly `negative-control-v2.json`) has already been published when the later collision rejects. This fails original #1252's requirement to refuse existing report/control destinations before any writes to the complete result set. The single-file writer correctly uses exclusive creation and checks symlink components; preserve those protections. The missing guarantee is complete-set admission, including failures in later positions, rather than an alleged overwrite of the collided original.
3. The control script imports materialized `scripts.evidence.immutable.Baseline` at line 49 without authenticating the actual imported helper against the frozen helper pin. `check-archive.py` (3,266 bytes, whole SHA256 `0f431cc60ef20a6293f1684147701f0b8e89b3edd1b86915ece156f861f71130`) similarly imports that helper at line 16. Baseline's descriptor proves frozen Git helper bytes, which is distinct from the materialized Python module being executed. In contrast, the main runner already checks the materialized helper against the inventory at lines 271–275; preserve that successful correction. The adjacent entrypoint import closure still needs its own truthful immutable proof before calculation.

Proposed actual isolated reproductions — NOT executed in this audit:

- Use an admitted managed exact-merge review slot and a disposable owned-root mirror containing byte-identical original runner, inventory and control code. Preserve originals, remove only copied control destinations, and set temporary directories inside that owned slot. Supply the original exact script/runner/inventory hashes to the actual control CLI. First run a positive case with the complete authentic retained e/f scientific outputs.
- For the run-proof case, replace BOTH complete private e/f outputs with the same complete JSON object containing six repeated copies of one legitimate subject (or six fabricated IDs/changed scientific values), retaining the required runner hash. Run the unchanged actual `verify-controls-v2.py` CLI and inspect its exit status and emitted reproducibility scope. The inspected implementation has no rejection predicate for these altered records. A correction must reject each case without relying solely on a changed byte hash or count.
- For complete-set publication, retain authentic private e/f science, prepare only a sentinel at the second control destination, and keep the first/third absent. Invoke the actual unchanged control CLI. Inspect all three complete destination states and sentinel bytes after the expected late FileExistsError. Repeat a third-position collision and a broken/symlink destination. Admission failure must leave every absent destination absent and all existing bytes unchanged.
- For executed-helper provenance, use a separate private mirror with an altered complete helper whose immutable inventory/Git pin remains unchanged. A benign marker in executed helper code can establish that the altered module really executed. Exercise both the actual control and archive entrypoints; require pre-execution/authentication rejection, or execute captured immutable bytes with a verified complete declared project import closure. Do not alter the real original helper or execute injected live/network actions.

Independent positive evidence already obtained:
All 18 added paths are identical ordinary-mode whole Git objects at head and merge. All 49 declared original whole-file hashes/lengths match (65,692,507 encoded bytes); every 59 numeric metric JSON pointer and every 59 rendered table row matches. Both retained native e/f outputs are actually byte-identical. Independently checked exact six original acceptance IDs, full 3,233 geoBoundaries unique shapeIDs, 244 crosswalk unique rows, all complete state GEOID rosters (67 AL /82 MS /95 TN), native/source/Census identity/name/STATE/COUNTY/LSADC/parent joins, all 18 raw-coordinate type/component/hole/vertex/bounds summaries and retained source-response byte/count/time bindings. The accepted ZIP central directory has seven members, declared total decoded size 17,480,047 and maximum 16,869,220 bytes; ZIP actual member hashes/CRC, Shapely validity and EPSG:5070 numerical recomputation have NOT run in this audit. Whole encoded plus declared ZIP decode gives 83,172,554 bytes before small new code/fixtures/results; measure actual complete correction phase again rather than assume that is final admission.

Why blocked / observable resume:
Fresh serialized storage checks failed: last measured free space 10,677,731,328 bytes, below the required 10,737,418,240. No review slot was allocated, no candidate producer/control was executed, and no original was replaced. The original #1259 audit remains Incomplete, with its exact unchecked scope recorded there. Resume actual adverse/positive tests and any final readiness transition only after a fresh allocation and each reproduction gate passes, complete code/input/output admission is measured, and the shared issue readiness/ownership/dependency review is complete. Static findings above are independently inspected code behavior; they are not fabricated executed pass receipts.

Success criteria, maximum one additive PR:
- Preserve original packets/code/source/archive bytes, historical metadata/results and the successful #1259 main-runner/input/metric/exclusive-writer corrections. Write only a separately owned new control/provenance vintage in the prefix below.
- Authenticate the exact six distinct full scientific outputs and all applicable inventory/source/code/geometry/metric/join bindings independently before claiming reproducibility; prove two genuinely complete authenticated runs, not two identically malformed documents. Reject duplicate/missing/fabricated/reassigned subjects and coherently changed scientific fields with both candidate file hashes refreshed. Do not rerun the oversized original worldwide/county generator.
- Authenticate the actual executed control/archive project modules and declared imports before calculation, preserving the original whole frozen baseline. Exercise actual adjacent entrypoints against a complete changed-helper fixture; reject drift or execute captured immutable bytes.
- Admit the complete control/result destination set before any mutation. Actual first/second/third-position ordinary collisions, symlink/broken-link/traversal/escaped paths and post-calculation failures must preserve sentinels, create no success receipt for an incomplete run, and leave no first-output success artifact after admission failure. Use a safe fresh whole-run vintage/receipt boundary or independently reviewed equivalent; never remove originals to make a rerun succeed.
- Actual fresh positive science/control/archive entrypoints and meaningful negative fixtures, two complete safe fresh runs, whole result readback, the preserved 59 standard numeric/table bindings and complete raw/decoded/code/result caps must pass with truthful execution/runtime proof and exact-head independent review. Record source/physical/legal limits and leave any separately unchecked scientific scope explicit.
- No legal boundary, coastal/offshore/island completeness, cause, current Census-host reauthentication or geographic/production approval is established. The archived 2018 cartographic IoUs remain historical unless separately remeasured with their original CRS/runtime limits. Do not reopen or change original closed work or worker budgets.

Deduplication and ownership: complete all-state discovery exhausted 15 pages (1,406 entries; 968 non-PR issues, 859 canonical work blocks). No existing issue or later main packet modification covers these three exact control/provenance gaps. The new dedicated prefix occurs nowhere in that inventory and conflicts with no existing concrete geography-owned prefix; implementation claims and existing broader work remain untouched. Dependencies are explicitly empty for the independent additive erratum; original closed work is read-only input, not a reopened prerequisite.

title: Authenticate six-county run proofs and preflight complete control outputs

body:
First independently raised 2026-10-06 America/Los_Angeles by Auditor `01a10892-0782-7b13-902c-d8b4db6c155d`. Affects PR #1084 merge `897fdd0fbac0e16e675a56a15883c22f533b51a3`, head `f0645d26621b3487f6fa67320395e5e627537430`, original closed #264. Preserve its closure/history. Existing #1079 owns the separate three-county/Minnesota source and boundary investigation. Shared engineering prevention #1309 owns common safeguards; this child owns adoption in this original packet only.

## Independently verified preservation and input-binding defects

The documented `reproduce.py` command writes directly to retained `geometry-and-membership-results.json` with `Path.write_text`. It offers no exclusive fresh output destination and no refusal to overwrite the original. `build-evidence-quality.py` similarly writes retained provenance, metric-inputs, positive/negative-control and manifest paths. Running the documented commands as an independent check can destroy the original evidence vintage rather than preserve it.

The reproducer reads checkout `data/hierarchy.json` and parts 25–27 directly. It does not compare these consumed bytes with the declared `metric-inputs.json` baseline before computation, and does not verify the consumed shared helper/code bytes. The evidence builder obtains baseline descriptors separately with `git show 8e1162e3e364cebdec700ec796e2730379494922:PATH` and labels result metrics with that commit, regardless of which checkout bytes the result producer actually consumed. Source descriptors are recalculated from present files rather than checked against immutable expected source pins. A structural assertion or recalculated descriptor does not prove a historical baseline was consumed. No allegation that the original author used wrong bytes is made: the Auditor checked that merged Atlas inputs equal the declared baseline.

Evidence: immutable merged scripts, all 37 GitHub changed-file identities (53,560,839 bytes), five baseline-file hashes, declared source/output descriptors, 12 metric bindings, and independently checked 186 unique names/IDs/GEOIDs/parents. The documented final-write path was intercepted in the Auditor's isolated run to protect the original; this is an audit adapter, not a delivered repair. Original result SHA-256 is `6aa450f637b419957d8207967365938ba3d51185afe7f69cc1ee918e82624182`.

Reproduction: inspect the exact merge's two scripts. The final writes target retained originals, without an exclusive destination/admission check. Trace the producer's hierarchy/part reads and the builder's separate `git show` baseline reads: there is no consumed-byte authentication joining them. Do not execute those original writes to demonstrate the defect. In an isolated fresh-vintage test, a changed required input/helper must fail before any output is admitted; a request naming an original output must fail without changing that file.

## Bounded success criteria

One focused PR, exactly the original 186 county subjects, original owned packet only. Preserve every original byte, ID, date, source, output, control and manifest; add a separately dated erratum/vintage rather than regenerate originals. Read immutable evaluation-commit Atlas/helper/code inputs or authenticate every consumed required byte against that vintage, retain full source bindings, and bind new results to the actual execution and evaluation commits. Require an exclusive fresh whole-run output set, reject existing destinations/symlinks/escaped paths before writing, and use real positive/tampered-input/occupied-output controls plus two independent complete runs with whole-file results and runtime provenance. Keep archived results and any precision differences honest; never relabel an old output as a new run or weaken equality silently. Verify all 186 joins, 99 Iowa/87 Minnesota, original 183/3 scope, state findings, and sibling-workload context. A new code erratum must not claim new source/legal truth, statewide completeness, geographic approval, import readiness or delivery.

Dependencies and ownership: #264 is closed; no implementation reservation is acquired by the Auditor. #1079 has a separate owned directory and factual scope; its genuine evidence/gate wait is unchanged. #1309 is a related shared-helper task, not permission to expand this child into shared code. If shared-helper availability is needed during implementation, coordinate an explicit dependency before claiming; never bypass the gate. Complete open/closed issue pagination and later original-packet Git history found no existing scoped repair for these defects. Related historical repairs #1302/#1306/#1308 own other original packets, so this is distinct adoption work.

Limits: these are independently inspected producer/preservation defects. Official Census documentation/authenticity, precise datum sensitivity, water/legal extent and small-fragment meaning are separate audit or #1079 scopes. Count/name/geometry validation is not scientific approval.

title: Preserve Iowa–Minnesota #1084 evidence and bind consumed reproduction inputs

body:
First independently raised by the post-merge Auditor on 2026-10-06 America/Los_Angeles. Affects PR #1158, exact merge `a32ae163473a42ed28d7bedf7e9930414beb54f8`, reviewed head `7eae2eb184cbd4e69a3c033e371cd91001a12763`. This is an additive engineering successor; preserve closed #1154 and its original completed input/source erratum.

## Independently verified defect

`data/regional-review/usa-adm2-lineage-981-erratum/reproduce.py` (whole-file SHA-256 `61abe57243f1c0fbe2b60712d7512de1f29717377e637de2a89e866a32125303`) admits `--run` without validating whether it is a safe run name or resolves inside OWNED. `dest = OWNED / "runs" / run_name / "findings"` discards the owned prefix when run_name is absolute. Exclusive `xb` writes prevent overwriting an individual existing file but do not establish output ownership. The final record unconditionally claims `written_exclusively_under_owned_path: true` even when this is false.

In a managed detached checkout of the exact merge, the unchanged CLI verified all 72 pins, completed the original calculation, exited 0 and wrote all three complete findings plus `reproduction-record.json` under this auditor's fresh private directory outside the declared packet. The report still set the ownership boolean true. Only fresh scratch in the auditor-owned slot was used; no foreign, retained or production files were written. All 72 retained inputs and 22 changed files were independently whole-byte/hash checked before/after and remain unchanged.

## Reproduction and expected behavior

In an isolated detached merge checkout containing all 72 pinned inputs, let AUDIT_DEST be a fresh absolute private directory inside that checkout but outside the declared owned packet. After storage admission:

```sh
python -B data/regional-review/usa-adm2-lineage-981-erratum/reproduce.py reproduce --run "$AUDIT_DEST"
```

Observed: exit 0; AUDIT_DEST/findings contains input-manifest.json (11,843 bytes), subject-crosswalk.jsonl (218,611 bytes), source-lineage-audit.json (12,229 bytes); AUDIT_DEST/reproduction-record.json asserts exclusive owned-path writing. Expected: reject an escaped destination before creating directories or writing any product. A permitted run must be fresh, completely preflighted, and resolve exclusively within the successor's declared output ownership.

## Bounded scope and success criteria

- Own only a new additive engineering successor under `coordination/engineering/usa-adm2-output-guard-1158/`. Do not edit the original geography wrapper or any original research/source/retained runs, catalog, hierarchy, geometry, IDs or dates. Document how to invoke the successor and the original's historical limits.
- Preserve and verify all 72 immutable whole-file pins from #1154 at `c42f4b7465964245ecbcd8eed4961eb76af3106b`; additionally pin the exact #1158 wrapper above at its actual merge. Use the same exact 279 subjects. All required input/output/controls phases stay within <=256 MiB, <=512 descriptors, <=32 MiB per ordinary/decoded file; the original 72 input bytes total 237,038,540.
- Validate safe run arguments and complete resolved output ownership before creating anything. Reject absolute and escaping traversal names, symlink escapes and collisions with any planned result or record. Do not create partial results when a destination is already occupied. Records must accurately describe the actual admitted output paths, not assert a constant ownership result.
- Meaningful bounded positive/negative controls exercise the actual successor CLI, proving zero new output on invalid destinations, input drift/missing pins, duplicate subjects and occupied destinations. Preserve pre-existing sentinels byte for byte. Two actual admitted runs reproduce all three original finding files byte for byte.
- Declare/bind all changed files, consumed immutable inputs, outputs, controls, numeric claims and source/geometry limits in the owned manifest and obtain distinct exact-head review. Initial Census source context remains explicitly unresolved where not restored; this output correction does not certify source legal applicability, boundaries, publication or import.

## Deduplication, dependencies and limits

Complete open/closed issue pagination (13 pages, 100x12+56) found no successor issue covering this #1158 wrapper. #1154 is a completed earlier erratum: do not reopen it merely to attach a new finding. #1239 concerns three different worldwide engineering producers; #1250 and #1252 concern different county/coastal executables. Preserve their scoped ownership. Full open-PR file reads show no overlap with this new successor prefix or the affected wrapper. Dependency #1154 is closed and its canonical claim is released. No implementation claim is acquired by the Auditor. Readiness will be decided after the shared read-only helper and a fresh dependency/ownership check.

Two actual safe runs independently reproduced the three original files byte for byte. Independent checks reproduced national unique counts 3,233, all 279 joins, 159/120 parent counts, 210 full/simplified geometry differences and 49,625 globally unique Atlas IDs across all 36 parts. This finding concerns output admission and a false execution receipt, not incorrect county results. Absolute-destination escape was actually executed; traversal/symlink negatives are required repair controls, not claimed completed auditor experiments. Official Census context-page bodies remain unrestored under the GitHub-only audit constraint; retained metadata/product notice are inspected and explicitly do not resolve legal applicability.

title: Guard USA county lineage #1158 owned output admission and execution receipts

body:
First raised by the post-merge Auditor on 2026-10-06 America/Los_Angeles. Original PR [#984](https://github.com/ChengshuLi/WorldAtlas/pull/984), immutable merge `f81f77eae61c9e537e7f160fef85b65925359c70`; original research #427. Additive source/reproduction erratum for exactly 245 original locations and four province assessments, at most two PRs under the disjoint owned path.

## Verified defects and reproduction

- `reproduce-review.py` discovers Atlas input through two mutable `data/geography/*.json` scans and reads current hierarchy without immutable input admission. Duplicate native IDs silently overwrite dictionary entries. Inspect both dictionary assignments: a later duplicate can replace earlier identity/geometry instead of being rejected. The Auditor independently checked all 36 world-index files and 49,625 unique IDs at the merge: no actual duplicate, omitted member or input drift was found. This finding concerns absent admission and fail-closed guards.
- The documented command creates `findings/` with `exist_ok=True`, opens three retained CSVs with `w`, and replaces three retained JSONs, overwriting the original evidence vintage. Its minimum committed-input phase is 278,504,907 bytes before snapshots and ZIP decompressions, exceeding the 256 MiB phase cap. Inspect these writes and complete inputs; do not run the unchanged command on retained evidence. The Auditor did not execute the unmodified whole generator.
- CBF2018's `.prj` declares NAD83/GRS1980. The generator ignores it and uses EPSG:4326→5070 for every source, while REVIEW describes WGS84. This is an undocumented datum interpretation; no displacement or changed classification has been demonstrated.
- `local-storage-check-before-retrieval.json` commits four local workspace ownership-token fields (`/entries/0/token` through `/entries/3/token`), contrary to local-only ownership/evidence rules. Do not reproduce the values publicly or in new evidence. These are local workspace tokens, not demonstrated remote credential compromise. Do not change foreign claims/workspace ownership. `local-storage-check-before-authority-documents.json` is zero bytes and proves no storage check; a matching inventory hash proves its emptiness only.

All 70 inventory entries otherwise match actual bytes. A complete independent all-world identity phase used 226,901,858 bytes; a separate complete source-science phase used 126,622,449 bytes including all original packet files, four verified containing parts, hierarchy and decoded ZIP members. Two bounded runs reproduced the three assessment CSVs and Bermuda/control JSONs byte-for-byte. Summary substantive fields matched; JSON ordering differs, and current Python3.12.14/Shapely2.1.2/pyproj3.7.2/pyshp2.3.1 differs from the unavailable historical runtime. Do not claim unmodified whole-command or historical-runtime reproduction.

## Success criteria

Preserve original bytes, numbers, dates, IDs and claims. Create a dated erratum and complete bounded input phases with immutable whole-file admission for every actual input/decompression, explicit dependence on the complete identity proof, and truthful source/metric bindings. Reject changed/duplicate IDs before computation, preserve exact roster requirements, write exclusive new output vintages, and prove existing-output refusal and changed-input/duplicate rejection using owned disposable fixtures. Do not split an oversized read merely to bypass caps or hide required inputs.

Declare each source CRS and justified datum operation/approximation. Preserve original scores; any new numerical effects need applicable shared geometry methods, controls, separate output vintages and independent exact-head source review. Publish a sanitized durable admission receipt/protocol omitting workspace tokens and unnecessary local details; record the zero-byte receipt honestly. Preserve historical evidence privately as required and avoid re-copying token values. Any shared/history/foreign-owner cleanup needs a separately authorized handoff; this issue does not authorize it.

## Readiness, dependencies and overlap

Blocked: #427 is closed and its reservation released, but four province subjects are hierarchy-array objects rather than native GeoJSON feature IDs. The containing-file checker requires `.features`. Review an accepted binding strategy or split bounded children before readiness; do not fabricate a registry or use copied identities as native ancestry. Also review the complete bounded phase plan.

#978 separately owns six county vintage/boundary diagnostics; #979 owns Bermuda authority/tier restoration; #1148 owns two native comparator-validity omissions. Preserve their ownership. #1141/#1145 describe analogous defects in different batches; #1138 was corrected by PR #1144, to be audited separately. Complete open/closed issue pagination found no existing issue covering this batch's reproduction and storage-receipt defects. Current open PR paths are disjoint. No geography approval, core edit, import, deployment or history rewrite.

title: Preserve bounded reproducibility and source CRS evidence for Southeastern batch 427

body:
First independently raised by the post-merge Auditor on 2026-10-06 America/Los_Angeles. Affected PR [#983](https://github.com/ChengshuLi/WorldAtlas/pull/983), exact merge `8a6a74d194bcde786c03b9acfa4c3b3a92ffc75e`; original research acceptance #428. Scope: one additive evidence-contract/source erratum for the exact 279 Georgia/Kentucky counties and their two named province parents. Maximum two focused PRs, in the new owned directory only.

## Inspected evidence, defects and reproduction

1. Six manifest units are wrong. In `evidence-quality.json`, the `largest_county_area_screen_by_state` metrics label the Georgia Ware land area 2,329,020,623 and Georgia state sum 149,486,624,386 as `count`, although the bound fields are explicitly square metres. Kentucky Pike 2,037,621,883 and state sum 102,282,853,408 have the same error. The shares 0.015580127 and 0.019921442 are also labelled `count`; they are dimensionless fractions. In `build-evidence-manifest.py`, `unit_for` excludes keys containing `count`; `county` contains that substring. Inspect these six metric IDs and the bound original summary pointers. Numeric values and the prose percentage calculations reproduce correctly; this finding does not allege a numerical factor-of-a-million error. Expected units are m2 and a dimensionless share (or explicitly converted percent), with consistent binding and summaries.

2. Input accounting omits 31 actual baseline parts. `reproduce.py` reads all 36 paths in the pinned `data/world-index.json`, but its `baseline_manifest` and final manifest retain only the five parts containing this region. Counting the full scan plus the five main retained geometry inputs gives a minimum 295,707,428 distinct committed input bytes, already above the 268,435,456-byte declared budget before scope/sibling snapshots, decoded membership and shapefile members. A 143,357,387-byte declared descriptor inventory is therefore not the complete execution inventory. Every ordinary source fits the 32 MiB cap; this is an aggregate/accounting problem. Reproduce the discrepancy by enumerating immutable index parts, measuring each Git blob, and comparing the executed reads with the manifest descriptors. Do not run the oversized combined generator or disable limits. Design independently reviewed bounded stages/children with actual complete inputs, immutable intermediate provenance and truthful current/archived vintages; merely splitting a list while executing the same undeclared combined work is insufficient.

The Auditor independently checked the complete identity scope in a separately declared 227,130,801-byte phase: 49,625 unique Atlas IDs, exact 1,422-member region, six disjoint batches, 159 Georgia/120 Kentucky county subjects. A separately declared 155,354,302-byte scientific phase read the five containing regional parts and all scoped comparator inputs. Two scratch-only executions of the inspected algorithm, with the read-loop bounded to those five parts and outputs relocated, produced all three original result files byte for byte: 279 assessments, seven IoUs per county, 176 bounded justified/103 insufficient-evidence. This does not certify the original unmodified combined command or repair its input contract.

3. Province acceptance is missing. #428 explicitly requires every scoped location and province to be individually classified `justified`/`correction-needed`/`insufficient-evidence`. The 279 rows are counties only. The prose names Georgia and Kentucky and checks parent counts, but no separate province disposition/evidence/limits is recorded. The actual hierarchy objects are `/2310` Georgia and `/2907` Kentucky at the pinned hierarchy; both retain open semantic/boundary review metadata. Do not infer province approval from county parentage, state counts, or the statement that States are primary governmental divisions. Give each parent a dated disposition and distinguish supported tier evidence from unresolved intermediate-grouping/territorial questions.

4. The cartographic comparator CRS needs an explicit source interpretation. The ZIP `.prj` declares NAD83/GRS1980; the script applies its common EPSG:4326→6933 transformer to that source without using or discussing the `.prj`. The published result is reproducible under that assumption, but the method labels all inputs WGS84 without documenting the datum relationship. Record actual CRS/axis order and the selected operation or a supported equivalence assumption, grids/accuracy/availability and numerical impact if calculated. No material displacement or changed classification was demonstrated by this audit. #1138 and #1141 cover the analogous defect for other exact subject sets; preserve their ownership rather than widening those contracts.

5. GeoBoundaries product reuse-basis research is shared with #1143. The retained per-product metadata accurately says Public Domain. The project's retained citation/use document separately discusses CC BY 4.0 product/derivative terms, underlying sources and attribution. Reuse #1143's common-product investigation; this erratum owns only applicability/uncertainty for #983 and must not launch a duplicate generic license investigation or widen #1143's 268 subjects. No unlawful-use finding or blanket substitution of license labels is made.

## Success criteria and preservation

- Preserve every original packet/source/receipt/metric, immutable IDs, geometry, dates and historical conclusions. Add evidence and revised interpretation in the new owned directory only.
- Fix the six unit declarations in the additive erratum; derive them from the actual field semantics and bind values/units to exact original inputs/outputs. Review metric provenance individually: the original builder assigns the assessment hash to every summary metric, including national/region counts and baseline byte sizes not derived from those county rows. Distinguish actual calculation inputs from a convenient output hash and document any aggregate provenance.
- Establish a complete, supported bounded reproduction strategy with no omitted reads, cap bypass or oversized reconstructed file. Preserve any necessary stage/child dependencies and original baseline vintages. Do not label copied/new subject registries as ancestor originals.
- Record one source-backed disposition for each of the two provinces, exact county-to-parent membership and unresolved limits. Retain the custom-region and initial-research approval limits.
- Document comparator CRS/measurement interpretation; preserve all diagnostic originals and their explicit MakeValid clone limits. Use the shared GeoBoundaries product-basis result from #1143 with a scoped applicability note.
- Prepare truthful versioned evidence and meaningful positive/negative/two-run checks as appropriate; obtain distinct exact-head source/method review. Do not propose a geography/catalog edit solely from a diagnostic score or unit correction.

## Deduplication, dependencies and readiness

Complete open/closed issue pagination (12 pages: eleven 100-item pages and one 44-item page) found no existing erratum for these units/input-accounting/province gaps. #980 and #981 are closed and their canonical reservations released; keep their history. Their corrective PRs #988/#989 require separate audits and are not treated as proof that this initial packet's evidence contract is complete. #1143 is reused for the common product terms. Open PRs #1142/#1144 were fully file-paginated and do not touch the new owned prefix; #1138's active worker and scope remain unchanged.

**Blocked, not claimable:** the two framework province IDs have actual hierarchy objects but are not native GeoJSON location features. Before marking ready, review a supported evidence subject-binding strategy for those parent objects and the full phased input/manifest budget, or split reviewed bounded children. The normal containing-file checker expects native GeoJSON features; inventing an ancestor registry or dropping the parent acceptance is not an acceptable workaround. Exact original county mappings and hierarchy object pointers are verified, but that does not establish a compliant future 281-subject manifest. Dependencies #428/#980/#981 are closed; this block concerns evidence readiness, not an unfinished worker claim. The Auditor has not reserved or implemented this work.

title: Correct East South Central evidence units, input accounting and province dispositions

body:
First independently raised by the post-merge Auditor on 2026-10-06 America/Los_Angeles. Original PR [#974](https://github.com/ChengshuLi/WorldAtlas/pull/974), immutable merge `e8d335fcab29ad9e1fe491a159cd395da1551741`; original source research #430. One additive erratum PR, preserving the retained packet.

## Findings and reproduction

1. `reproduction-controls.json` claims that a deliberately duplicated roster was rejected. `reproduce-crosswalk.py` converts `member_location_ids` to a set before asserting `len(ids)==160` and later `len(set(ids))==160`; it never constructs or rejects a duplicated-roster fixture. Independently applying those exact roster guards to the 160 captured IDs plus a duplicate accepts all 161 entries after set conversion (160 unique). Recomputing the captured roster digest for this altered list also passes the digest comparison. This is a failed uniqueness guard and an unsupported negative-control claim, separate from the genuine executed swapped-axis control. The auditor tested the exact roster guards, not a full modified-input replay.

2. The retained Census CBF ZIP `.prj` declares NAD83 / GRS1980. The script does not read that CRS: it uses a common EPSG:4326→5070 transform for the CBF and GeoJSON inputs, and passes CBF coordinates into the shared WGS84 area helper. The review omits the datum assumption. This is an undocumented interpretation/operation, not a demonstrated numerical displacement or changed boundary classification. The same archive/datum omission is already reported for the separate 254 Texas subjects in #1138; preserve that issue's exact scope. This issue owns the South Atlantic packet's erratum only.

3. #430 explicitly requires each scoped location and province to receive an individual justified/correction-needed/insufficient-evidence disposition. The packet provides 160 location rows, but no individual assessments of the four province subjects listed in its captured `province_scopes`. Matching a location's state parent does not supply its parent's own semantic-tier/repeated-tier disposition. In particular, Census describes DC itself as county-equivalent without primary divisions. This observation does not prove the Atlas parent or repeated level wrong: record the actual purpose, support and uncertainty for each of the four parents.

## Independently verified evidence and limits

The auditor byte-verified all 39 changed files at the exact PR head and merge, and all 30 retained-source descriptors. A bounded read-only replay with only import/output relocation reproduced all five retained outputs exactly: 161 Census and current-source crosswalk rows, 160 subject rows, controls and summary. All 3,233 raw GeoBoundaries geometries are natively valid in the inspected runtime; the script's conditional `buffer(0)` repair was not triggered by these raw source geometries. The Fairfax city/county distinction is supported by the retained Virginia definitions, Fairfax charter and independent Census GEOIDs; its implementation remains #976. Diagnostic vintage differences remain #968. A replay matching a false receipt does not validate the receipt's factual control claim.

No live Census/Virginia HTTP ancestry or legal survey verification was performed. Province semantic disposition and full source-to-Atlas lineage still need review. No original source, geometry, identity, historical record, claim, release or deployment was changed.

## Success criteria

- Create a new dated erratum under the sole owned path below; retain original bytes, claims, dates, IDs and historical measurements as immutable originals.
- Execute a meaningful duplicated-roster negative control against the raw list before any deduplication, with a recomputed consistent roster digest. Record the actual rejection, plus a valid exact-roster positive case and swapped-axis outcome. Do not claim an experiment merely from redundant set assertions. Keep execution read-only with new exclusive output paths.
- Declare each comparator's actual CRS and the datum operation/approximation, accuracy and limits. If measuring an effect, use shared methods, genuine controls and two reproducible new vintages with truthful input bindings. Do not silently relabel NAD83 coordinates or retrospectively change original numbers.
- Assess Virginia, DC, Maryland and Delaware individually at the source/semantic level, using exact citations, geographic role, repeated-tier purpose and explicit justified/correction-needed/insufficient-evidence outcomes. Unresolved facts may remain explicit research limits; this does not approve parent geometry.
- Correct the handoff description: #954 has an exact separate 216-subject scope, not a worldwide ownership grant. Coordinate source facts with #968 and #1138 without changing their subjects or owned paths.
- Obtain independent exact-head source/measurement review. No shared hierarchy/geography/catalog edits, import, deployment, legal-boundary certification or geography approval.

## Readiness, dependencies and ownership

Blocked, not claimable yet. #430 is closed and its canonical reservation is released. The exact 160 location subjects occur in the pinned Atlas GeoJSON parts. The four province subjects occur in the pinned hierarchy and captured scope, but an accepted evidence-baseline subject binding for those four parents has not been independently established. Resolve this precise baseline-binding gap in a reviewed issue contract before changing to ready; do not invent a new registry and call it an ancestor baseline or omit the parent scope to bypass the gate.

Complete open/closed issue pagination and all files of current open PRs #1139/#1140 found no existing erratum covering these controls/parent dispositions and no competing owned path. #968 separately owns vintage/geometry differences, #976 Fairfax implementation, #954 a distinct regional lineage scope, #1138 Texas source interpretation, and #433 combined regional integration. Do not take their claims or enlarge their scopes. Missing primary evidence is a research objective; unresolved subject binding is a readiness blocker.

title: South Atlantic: correct review controls and document province dispositions

body:
Parent: #264, which recorded a source-boundary difference and recommends this bounded investigation. This work does not modify shared geography or approve the Interior North America branch.

**Read-only source/semantic investigation, exactly three Minnesota counties plus their state parent.** The pinned `gbOpen/USA/ADM2` metadata identifies its source as U.S. Census MAF/TIGER, represented year 2018, source-data update Jan. 19, 2023, build Dec. 12, 2023, Public Domain, and points to the Census cartographic-boundary product. Independent Census TIGERweb 2018 and current 2026 county layers both contain the same 186 Iowa/Minnesota GEOIDs. The Atlas geometries closely follow the 2018 Census 1:500,000 cartographic product, which Census documents as generalized for small-scale maps and unsuitable for precise area or geographic-relationship analysis. For Cook (27031), the cartographic/TIGERweb Jaccard is 0.4812; for Lake (27075), 0.7644. Those differences do not establish that Lake Superior water explains them. Koochiching (27071) has seven Atlas polygon parts versus one in the cartographic/geoBoundaries representation: a main component, one approximately 2,129 m² component covered by the source, one approximately 206 m² component outside it, and four tiny components. Their status as land remnants, water, or topology artefacts is unresolved. Minnesota’s county-union and state representation also needs complete-footprint review.

Affected exact Atlas subjects:
- `gb:USA:ADM2:52423323B35428884505626` — Cook County, Minnesota; Census GEOID `27031`.
- `gb:USA:ADM2:52423323B21927262007954` — Lake County, Minnesota; Census GEOID `27075`.
- `gb:USA:ADM2:52423323B71326746759120` — Koochiching County, Minnesota; Census GEOID `27071`.
- `framework:province:minnesota:bf75ad975e19` — Minnesota parent province/state extent and its relationship to the counties above.

**Acceptance:** inspect and retain lawful, pinned official evidence that establishes what extent the county and state shapes represent; examine Census cartographic boundaries, TIGER/Line/TIGERweb, relevant state/tribal/federal boundary responsibilities and source lineage; establish data vintage, source generalization, license/reuse, water versus land extent and neighboring-boundary completeness. Compare all three exact counties and the complete Minnesota state parent against independent authoritative sources using `worldatlas-evidence-geometry-v1`, with positive/negative controls and per-subject findings. Classify each affected subject justified, correction-needed, or insufficient-evidence; state an engineering handoff if an Atlas geometry correction or a different source is warranted. If evidence cannot settle the representation, document limits and lawful restoration instructions. No shared geometry edits, location imports, production writes, regional approval, deployment, or historical claims.

This child is blocked on #264 completing its evidence handoff. Once ready, take only the exact owned path below, preserve source and evidence history, and follow the current geography, workspace, evidence-review, and serialized-claim/merge protocols.

Two separately disclosed recomputations with Shapely 2.1.2 matched both retained tables exactly and all numerical results; the original script names Shapely 2.0.7, which was not available in this auditor environment. Independently verified identical/disjoint/one-third partial-overlap and raw duplicated-roster controls. New measurements must use the applicable shared method, real controls, immutable inputs and separate dated outputs; the original planar EPSG:4326 score remains a labelled diagnostic, never legal proof.

The missing external state/county coastal evidence is this bounded research objective, rather than evidence permitting a canonical edit. The initially empty open-PR inventory was refreshed; all files of subsequently discovered PR #1142 were inspected and have no owned-path overlap. No active claim exists on this issue. Ownership, 57 subjects, one-PR budget and source-comparison acceptance remain unchanged. Ready for source research under the normal claim/evidence gates. No auditor implementation or reservation.

title: Adjudicate South Atlantic county boundary differences for 57 scoped units

body:
Parent: #430. This blocked follow-up covers all 160 Atlas locations and 161 underlying GeoBoundaries source features in the South Atlantic packet. The initial #430 screen found 34 source features below 0.95 equal-area IoU versus the 2018 Census small-scale cartographic layer, 63 below that screen versus current 2026 Census TIGER, and 19 Atlas geometries below that screen versus their retained raw GeoBoundaries sources. These are diagnostic differences only; none identifies which version is correct.

## Exact scope and ownership

Only the exact 160 Atlas IDs in `evidence_quality.subject_ids`; their source lineage includes the two Fairfax source features documented in #430. Owned packet path: `data/regional-review/regional-review-south-atlantic-carto-differences-430/`. The issue depends on #430 and is blocked until its source audit merges.

## Acceptance

- Retain the exact inputs and compare each of the 161 underlying GeoBoundaries shapes with its matched 2018 Census cartographic and current 2026 TIGER geometry. Also report Atlas-to-retained-source differences for each of the 160 rows. Use documented source IDs/GEOIDs, names and state parents; never match by name alone.
- Retrieve the best available authoritative Census/TIGER source geometry matching the stated GeoBoundaries source vintage. Preserve original bytes, URL, retrieval time, exact hash, license and restoration instructions.
- For every subject, separate source-vintage change, cartographic generalization, boundary change, water/coast treatment, identity mismatch and unexplained differences. Use positive/negative controls and a reproducible method; do not treat an IoU threshold as legal proof.
- Verify county/county-equivalent role, state parent, Census GEOID, neighboring county/city tier, and multipart/interior-ring structure individually. Classify each subject justified, correction-needed or insufficient-evidence; create narrower engineering/source-restoration handoffs for evidenced corrections.
- Preserve the source-hash discrepancy already tracked in #954; do not overwrite the shared pin or duplicate that global lineage investigation.
- Obtain exact-head independent review and use the normal serialized merge queue. This packet cannot approve the South Atlantic region, boundary publication or historical imports.

Parent: #431. Bounded source-boundary research follow-up for the exact Texas county geometry signals that remained insufficient-evidence, plus the Texas parent outline. The parent packet is `data/regional-review/regional-review-508c7e9f3a462f8f/`.

This issue does not certify the Southeastern North America region, the full West South Central division, or authorize geometry imports. The parent evidence supports county identity/tier and current Texas membership but leaves the exact findings below unresolved. The source-hash question is also tracked separately in #954, whose location scope is disjoint and does not resolve these Texas units.

## Owned scope

- Exactly 24 Texas county IDs below, identified by source signals in the parent packet’s row-level evidence.
- Texas province outline `framework:province:texas:d326ad9fd3b4`, for the outer-boundary/source relationship only. The 254-county membership decision remains documented in #431.

## Acceptance

- Obtain dated, authoritative Texas state boundary evidence and investigate the province outline’s source/vintage/parent lineage. Resolve or explicitly retain its boundary uncertainty.
- For each of the 24 IDs, consult appropriate dated primary state, county, court, survey, and boundary-history records as available; document boundary date, land/water treatment, source transformation/generalization, islands/disconnected parts, and completeness. Census comparison differences alone are not legal proof.
- Specifically resolve why Brewster County is a single Polygon in the pinned 2018 GeoBoundaries source but two components in current Atlas.
- Reproduce the source, Census 2018 TIGER, 2018 Census 1:500,000 CBF, and 2025 TIGER comparisons from #431; explain discrepancies from affirmative evidence, not an overlap threshold. Classify each owned county as justified, correction-needed, or insufficient-evidence.
- If a source correction is warranted, provide a sourced engineering handoff listing exact IDs, applicable vintage, replacement or restoration bytes/URL/hash, license, transformation, and expected geometry; do not modify shared source pins or core geography in this research item.
- Preserve findings and original evidence under the owned path; run scope/evidence reproduction and obtain independent exact-head review. No production records, regional approval, import, publication, or deployment.
